card.name: Predicting the word fall (season)
card.fires_on: Words just before a likely 'fall' or 'autumn' season mention, in text about seasons, migration, planting, breeding or timing. The marked word is often a function word or a partial word, not 'fall' itself.

modes.label: Seasonal timing lists
modes.description: Spot just before a season such as fall in migration, breeding or planting text.

modes.label: Plant and animal cycles
modes.description: Words in gardening or wildlife passages where the next stage or season is likely to be fall.

modes.label: Autumn treatment timing
modes.description: Words in seasonal timing phrases about starting something in autumn.
modes.example: Initiate treatment in<< the>> autumn prior to onset of seasonal depressive symptoms

card.writes: It raises 'fall' and its variants and lowers 'summer' words in several languages.
card.plain: It fires on words where the text is about to name the fall season, as in migration, planting or breeding timing.
